name: How do I know if I have mold in my home?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if I have mold in my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: You might suspect mold if you notice a musty odor, see visible discoloration or fuzzy growth on surfaces, or experience unexplained allergy-like symptoms. Mold often thrives in damp, dark areas like basements, bathrooms, or behind walls after water damage. If you suspect mold but can't see it, a professional inspection can help identify hidden growth and assess the extent of the problem, ensuring all affected areas are addressed.
acceptedAnswer.description: Signs of mold include a musty smell, visible growth, or unexplained allergy symptoms. A professional inspection can confirm its presence, especially if hidden.
